prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, The Weather Maintenance Office. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Storm blue, butter yellow and washed teal, weather-service vests with tiny clean accessories. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Female-read fog sweeper. low broad round splat, narrowed focused eyes. One compact cue: short hand broom gathering one soft puff of fog.
2. Male-read hail sorter. tall pear, counting with one raised eyebrow. One compact cue: tiny open egg carton with a few round hailstones.
3. Male-read wind surveyor. lean sideways curl, bewildered gaze, mouth ajar. One compact cue: short windsock bent the wrong way on a stubby pole.
4. Female-read rain dispatcher. round diamond blob, determined side-eye, flat closed lips. One compact cue: small umbrella-shaped shutoff valve.
5. Male-read barometer attendant. squat square, alarmed eyebrows, narrow worried mouth. One compact cue: large single-dial barometer with clear glass.
6. Male-read cloud quality inspector. wide bean, downcast eyes, faintly disappointed frown. One compact cue: one soft miniature cloud with a shallow dent.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.
